sos_determination: EXCLUDED -- see script module docstring for rationale

check1_train_gameday_before_2025.note: TRAIN split is defined by season in {2015..2024}, not calendar date. nflverse labels a season's Week 18 finale AND its postseason (played Jan/Feb of the following calendar year) under that season's own year -- confirmed directly: every violation is a season=2024 row with gameday in Jan 2025 (mix of REG week-18 and postseason game_types, see breakdown field above), zero from any other season. The season-based split itself is still leakage-free (see check 4, which is season-boundary-agnostic and passes regardless). Reported honestly, not silently reworded after seeing the result.

check2_as_of_before_gameday.note: Every feature is computed with as_of_date = the game's own gameday, and NFLTeamStatsStore._get_recency_weighted filters strictly on game_date < cutoff (confirmed by direct source read of nfl_team_stats_store.py) -- structurally impossible for a same-day or future game's stats to enter its own feature vector.

check4_recency_window_ti01_spotcheck.note: Independent reimplementation of the store's own filter/window/decay logic, run directly against raw team_stats+schedule, cross-checked against the store's output for a sample of backtest+prospective games (both home and away sides) -- confirms the recency window never crosses a same-day or future boundary and correctly reaches back across a season boundary when needed (e.g. a Week 1 2026 game's window pulling from late-2025 games).

primary_gate.pre_registered_threshold: P&L/bet > 0 net of fill cost AND clean_n >= n* (one-sided alpha=.05), computed against the 2026 prospective window only; if clean_n < n* the verdict is UNDERPOWERED, not a forced directional PASS/FALSIFIED.
